description: Ground truth for Module 6 (PPTX ingestion), written BEFORE the first ingestion. Slide text facts come from the slide XML (read independently; every text run was checked to reach the parser output). Figure facts were written by viewing each picture the parser sends (VM slides 21, 34, 37; Lab2 slide 4). Decorative slides: their only pictures carry no information (VM slide 40: celebration illustration). Regexes are case-insensitive and must match the slide's chunk (title + content). Each deck gets its own course.
